takes.text: [low, quiet, waking up] He opens his eyes.
[uneasy, hushed] Bare concrete... on every side.
[slow, steady] Bolted to the floor... a steel desk. A black screen. One chair.
[low] And at the far end of the room... a heavy steel door.

script_lines.text: [slow, quiet] He stands up... and walks toward the door. [tense, hushed] His hand searches along the cold iron edge. Nothing. No handle. Sealed completely from the outside.
[low, focused] On the screen... a test. Task four hundred and twelve. [strained, frustrated] He stares into the code, pushing his mind to find an answer. Nothing comes. The lock is solid.
[exhausted, indifferent] Under the desk, an old iron drawer. Standard manuals. Tools he was told to use. [restless, quiet] None of it helps. He tears through the files, tossing them across the floor.
[whispered, sudden realization] Then... his fingers hit the very back of the drawer. [hushed, chilling] Past the last folder. A folded scrap of paper... wedged into the steel seam.
